_comment: Your own gear with your own numbers: rings, necklaces, bracelets, charms, armour, weapons, shields, offhands. After editing: close the game, run install-custom-gear.cmd (in chSERVER) so the game knows the items, then restart the server. Get one in game with .give <id>.

_fields.id: a new item id: 90100 and up (custom-items.json uses 90001-90099)
_fields.name: shown in game
_fields.type: ring, necklace, bracelet or charm: picks a default look, so 'look' can be left out
_fields.look: an existing item (id or exact name) whose model, icon, equip slot and weapon animations it copies; needed for armour, weapons, shields and offhands. None of its stats are kept.
_fields.damage: weapons: damage by type, e.g. {"Slash": 300, "Cold": 120}. Types: Pierce, Slash, Crush, Heat (Fire), Cold (Ice), Magic, Poison, Divine, Chaos, True
_fields.speed: weapons: attack delay in milliseconds (smaller is faster); leave out to keep the look's
_fields.range: weapons: attack range in metres; leave out to keep the look's
_fields.abilities: any ability by name, e.g. {"Treasure Hunter": 800, "Scholar": 800, "Fortitude": 100, "Sword": 50, "Critical Strike": 100}
_fields.skills: +ranks to skills by name, e.g. {"Fire Bolt": 2, "Pummel": 1}
_fields.proc: a chance to cast a skill on hit: {"skill": "Fire Bolt", "level": 10, "chance": 5} (chance in percent)
_fields.equipSkill: a skill the item gives while worn (name or id)
_fields.stars: star level shown on the icon (optional)
_fields.tradeable: false to make it untradeable (default true)
_fields.skillDamage: flat damage added to a skill, e.g. {"Double Shot": 50} (skills gives ranks instead)
_fields.regen: health and energy per tick, e.g. {"health": 25, "energy": 25}
